statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was performed using CPT 93229.
The service enables continuous ambulatory monitoring of the symptomatic events.
The service addresses documented palpitations, dizziness, and giddiness.
The service correlates symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
